# Lunada Bay Mortgage (lunadabaymortgage.com)

> Jumbo and non-conventional home financing for Palos Verdes and coastal Los Angeles, including foreign-national and self-employed borrowers. A coastal-market service of West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc. Available in English and Chinese.

Lunada Bay Mortgage is the Palos Verdes and coastal Los Angeles arm of West Coast Capital Mortgage Inc., led by broker Anatoliy Kanevsky in the Los Angeles area. It focuses on jumbo and interest-only jumbo loans, foreign-national financing, DSCR and investor loans, and self-employed and bank-statement qualifying for coastal and high-value properties.

- Market: Palos Verdes and coastal Los Angeles
- NMLS #2817729 · CA DRE Corporation License #02440065 · Broker Anatoliy Kanevsky NMLS #2775380 · CA DRE #01385024
- Contact: 310-654-1577 · Los Angeles area
- Equal Housing Opportunity. Rates and program availability change; nothing here is a commitment to lend.

## Programs
- [Jumbo loans](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/jumbo-loans): Financing above conforming limits for coastal LA homes.
- [Interest-only jumbo](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/interest-only-jumbo): Interest-only structures for high-value purchases.
- [Foreign-national mortgage](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/foreign-national-mortgage): Financing for non-US-resident buyers.
- [Self-employed mortgage](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/self-employed-mortgage): Qualifying options for business owners.
- [Bank-statement loans](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/bank-statement-loans): Income from deposits for self-employed borrowers.
- [DSCR loans](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/dscr-loans): Investor loans qualified on rental income.
- [Non-QM mortgage](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/non-qm-mortgage): Alternative-documentation financing.
- [Cash-out refinance](https://lunadabaymortgage.com/cash-out-refinance): Pull equity from a coastal property.
